A claimed cell carries a role (Tab → Territory): base, housing, fields or wild resources.
Fire runs from one flammable tile to the next, twice as fast in the wind. Rain puts it out.
A book can also fail you: Reading and Perception decide, and a bad failure destroys the book.
An ability is composed: a shape, a core, modifiers. Tab → Abilities to assemble another one.
A raid heads for the heart of the claim: assigned guards, walls and turrets make up your defence.
A companion takes free orders: follow me, wait here, stance, fall back — from their dialogue.
Anything you place can be dismantled (right click): a badly placed piece of furniture is never lost.
Every brood fills the register (Tab → Register): variety and species milestones give real bonuses.
Wild plants grow back outside claimed cells — no need to gather everything at once.
Hunger eats at your stats before your health: a cooked dish feeds you better than raw meat, and without the risk.
You cannot swim laden: drop some weight, or go around. Under water your breath drains and Fire will not fire.
Walls and veins are harvested with a pickaxe, trees with an axe: the tool in hand decides what you get.
